description:
Agent Governance & Control (AGC): Spring Boot library for governed LLM and AI agent tool execution—ToolInvocationGateway,
        tool registry, RBAC-style policy, guardrails, append-only audit by traceId, optional REST (agc-api).
        Use cases: enterprise agents, compliance-oriented audit, safe tool calling on the JVM.
        Maven: io.github.ranasl62:agc-spring-boot-starter. Search: agc-spring-boot-starter, LLM tool governance Java, Spring Boot agent policy.
